REST API Authentication Guide

Version 2.4 | Last updated October 1, 2026

Overview

All requests made to the Acme Developer Platform API must include an authorized token in the HTTP Authorization header. Unauthorized calls return an HTTP 401 response status code.

Generating an API Key

  1. Log into your Acme Developer Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Settings > API Keys > Create New Secret.
  3. Store the displayed API secret key in a secure secrets manager.

Making an Authenticated Request

Pass your token inside the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix:

curl -X GET "https://api.acme.example.com/v1/projects" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

Handling Token Expiration

Access tokens expire every 3600 seconds (1 hour). Use the refresh token endpoint to obtain a new access token without requiring manual re-authentication.
